params._comment: R27 (§17.3 fork (a)): the Cell's play loop over the duck's map vocabulary -- the node is the map EPM's winner (pi_cell_size 0), the value field is the place TLE, the climb is the bearing to the most novel reachable node (wander_stall_ticks 0: the Cell's A2, so the climb engages).
